23449.overview: BS F-Zero Grand Prix 2 is the direct sequel to the original F-Zero game released for the Super Famicom via the Satellaview. Two versions were released - a non-SoundLink game and a SoundLink game. The original non-SoundLink version was released as BSF-Zero 2 Practice on June 1, 1997 (although the title screen remained the same). It contained the four courses first seen throughout BS F-Zero Grand Prix (a Satellaview remake of the original), along with a new course called Mute City IV. Little is known about the later SoundLink version outside of surviving videos, but it was distributed in two halves in August 1997 and had a similar announcer and redone soundtrack as the previous Satellaview entry. At least the first week rearranged a few courses, and replaced two with new locations called "Forest I" and "Forest II". Presuming no areas were repeated, this likely means the SoundLink version had twice as many courses total. In addition, it can be seen that the player cannot choose between Grand Prix and Practice modes in the SoundLink version; as it was a live broadcast, the player is forced to play each course in a timed Practice mode, and then the Grand Prix race.

126745.overview:
BS Fire Emblem: Akaneia Senki is a Downloadable 4-part Soundlink game for the Satellaview that was broadcast in at least 3 distinct runs between September 28, 1997 and May 1, 1999.

Princess Nyna has been captured by the Dolhr Empire, and the Kingdom of Archanea stands on the brink of collapse. Minerva, Princess of Macedon, embarks on a daring mission to rescue her before the resistance is lost. The first episode of BS Fire Emblem: Archanea Saga, set between Shadow Dragon and Mystery of the Emblem.

126836.overview:
BS Fire Emblem: Akaneia Senki is a Downloadable 4-part Soundlink game for the Satellaview that was broadcast in at least 3 distinct runs between September 28, 1997 and May 1, 1999.

A band of thieves with a strong sense of justice crosses paths with Minerva during another mission of the resistance. Strategy and clever tactics are essential to protect the innocent and recover valuable resources. The third episode of BS Fire Emblem: Archanea Saga.

126837.overview:
BS Fire Emblem: Akaneia Senki is a Downloadable 4-part Soundlink game for the Satellaview that was broadcast in at least 3 distinct runs between September 28, 1997 and May 1, 1999.

The mission reaches its conclusion as the fate of Archanea begins to unfold. Old allies unite for the decisive battle in a chapter that bridges the events of Fire Emblem: Mystery of the Emblem. The final episode of BS Fire Emblem: Archanea Saga.

166042.overview: BS Tantei Club is a detective story that was broadcast in 3 parts. The game is a text-based point-and-click-style adventure game where still images are presented to the player and the player may guide a hand-shaped icon around the screen to select objects in the image to investigate further. A number of icons in a side-bar present the player with options such as taking notes, speaking, or placing telephone calls. Similar gameplay was used in other games from the FDS era including the popular Shadowgate.
